profile.headline: Senior Data Engineer | SQL, Spark, Cloud

Interested in transitioning toward more AI/ML-focused work, ideally at a company where I can leverage my existing data-infra skills while learning modern ML practice.

career_history.title: Senior Data Engineer
career_history.description: Backend + data hybrid role at a growth-stage startup. Shipped a couple of small predictive features but the bulk of the role was data infrastructure.

career_history.title: Software Engineer
career_history.description: Backend development with Python (FastAPI), PostgreSQL, and Redis at a B2B SaaS product. Strong on API design, database performance, and reliability engineering.

career_history.title: Backend Engineer
career_history.description: Mixed data science and analytics-engineering role at a marketing-analytics startup. career_history.title: Analytics Engineer

Worked closely with the data science team to make sure feature pipelines aligned with what their models needed. Most of my career has been data engineering, with some adjacent ML exposure.
